author: MangoSmoothie_
body:
Hey, I thought I would make this thread because I want to make a map and probably other people want to make a map which the community likes.

So I ask...

What would you like in a map?

Is it a certain amount of monuments?
Big or Small?
Iron? Diamonds? No Ores?

Post your opinion below… I will definitely these ideas into practice when I make a map!

title: What do you want in a map?

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: It'd be nice to have more innovative maps. Instead of sticking to DTM, we should introduce new gamemodes or submodes made by you guys.
replies.body_tagged: It'd be nice to have more innovative maps. Instead of sticking to DTM, we should introduce new gamemodes or submodes made by you guys.

replies.author: hasl
replies.body: I prefer the original style of maps, such as Ternio, you have your teams island, a void, then the opposition. The maps with all the big terrain and such, they're just not as good gameplay for my taste, but some prefer that style of maps.

replies.author: UmbreonMessiah
replies.body: I like to have multiple levels built for me. Don't make it a flat thing, add height to it, make it so that I can shoot down on people or get shot down on. If it's DTM, I like to have very limited diamond things, so that the diamond will be highly sought after, making it a challenge. I also prefer island maps, like Ternio or Quintus.
